sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: A blue-green subshrub of deserts, semi-deserts and arid slopes in central and western Asia. It is usually 30–70 cm tall.

sections.title: Leaves and fruit
sections.text: The fleshy leaves are about 1.5–3 cm long. The flowers are small; the dry fruit bears membranous wings about 1.5–2.5 cm long that aid dispersal.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: No reliable food use is documented in the sources consulted.
